title: trench_pull_fluidity: force-balance analysis of the Cerpa et al. Fluidity subduction models
description:
Post-processing code accompanying How topographic pressure gradients drive subducting plates. It measures the vertically integrated horizontal force balance of two free-subduction models directly from the vertical normal stress, and partitions the plate-wide driving force into trench pull, ridge push and the tilting force.

Every figure in the paper and its supplement is produced by one named script, each writing a CSV of the numbers quoted in its caption. The reference snapshot of both runs and the reduced time-series caches are bundled, so no figure requires a download to reproduce.

This repository contains no model code and no new simulations. The model output analysed here is published separately by Cerpa et al. (2022), doi:10.5281/zenodo.6817177, under CC-BY-4.0; two of its snapshots are redistributed here under that licence.
